objective: Test stronger candidates than YOLO26n and prepare a reproducible public submission.
data_policy: Same immutable 18-class cleaned splits; no test-driven candidate changes. No label merging.
budget_note: YOLO26s has up to24 newepochs; YOLO11s inherits12 +up to16 newepochs and uses768px. Architecture, budget and resolution effects are not isolated.
fallback: Keep validated YOLO26n if neither candidate improves validation mAP50-95. No promise of large gain.
